digest.component_or_area: bridge CLI and engine reconcile vocabulary
propositions: Legacy rebar reconcile and python -m rebar_reconciler remain default dry-run and live respectively while canonical bridge preview and sync become the primary vocabulary
Argument-less calls and --mode flag retain all documented behavior and numeric exit codes without collision
--only and --except narrow differ inputs before examination whereas legacy --filter-local-ids retains post-differ write filtering
Selection resolution fails atomically with exit 2 before lock/sync/fetch/mutation if any token is unresolvable or disappears between preflight and locked load
Bridge sync --max-changes applies deterministic partition caps with retained audit manifests while uncapped live and legacy bootstrap output remain unchanged
Library, MCP, workflow, external-DC helper and older checked-out environments preserve their prior entrypoint paths and compatibility facades
